source.detail: synthetic fixture: hand-assembled MySQL 8.0 EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON document, not captured from a live server. The shape (query_block / nested_loop / table / ordering_operation / grouping_operation / union_result / materialized_from_subquery / cost_info, numeric cost and filtered strings) was verified against MySQL Server 8.0 mysql-test expected output (explain_json_all.result) and against DBX's own MySQL EXPLAIN JSON consumer (apps/desktop/src/lib/diagram/explainPlan.ts). Table names, row counts and costs are synthetic test data. Scenario: SELECT name, value FROM settings WHERE id = 1.
